sendWhy.ip: Cause: Brevo blocks addresses it does not know. For Masse’s publisher to fix, in Brevo (Security → Authorised IPs).
sendWhy.cle: Cause: Brevo refuses Masse’s key. For Masse’s publisher to fix.
sendWhy.expediteur: Cause: the sending address is not validated at Brevo. For Masse’s publisher to fix.
sendWhy.compte: Cause: sending is not yet activated on the Brevo account. For Masse’s publisher to fix.
sendWhy.cle-smtp: Cause: the stored key is Brevo’s SMTP key; its API key is needed (it starts with “xkeysib-”). For Masse’s publisher to fix.
sendWhy.cle-forme: Cause: the stored key does not look like a complete Brevo API key (it starts with “xkeysib-” and is about 90 characters long). For Masse’s publisher to fix.

request.waWelcome: Hi {first}! It's a yes from me, welcome. Your Masse app is open: I'm preparing your programme and will get back to you very soon.

pending.title: Thank you, {first}
pending.body: Your coach is reading your answers and will get back to you on WhatsApp. Your app opens as soon as it is approved.
pending.bodyCall: Your coach is reading your answers, and you will go over them on the video call. Your app opens as soon as it is approved.
pending.changeBody: You can withdraw your request at any time, as long as it is not approved.
pending.cancelBody: Your request, your account and your answers will be erased at once. The booked video call will be cancelled.
pending.cancelFailed: That did not work. Try again, or message your coach.

passkeys.title: Passkey
passkeys.lede: Come back to Masse with Face ID, your fingerprint or your device’s code, without waiting for an e-mail.
passkeys.added: It is on. Next time, choose “Sign in with my passkey”.
passkeys.exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.
passkeys.addFailed: That did not go through. Try again; the e-mail code always works.
passkeys.note: One passkey per device or keychain. The e-mail code always remains; Masse receives neither your face nor your fingerprint.
passkeys.signInHint: Face ID, fingerprint or device code. Turn it on once in settings, after a first sign-in by e-mail.
passkeys.signInFailed: No passkey recognised here. Sign in with the e-mail code, then turn one on in settings.

summary.title: Summary to send · W{n}
summary.lede: A few lines written from the week’s figures. Add your feedback, then send it to {first} on WhatsApp: Masse sends nothing.
summary.noPhone: No number on {first}’s file: copy the text and paste it where you talk.
summary.greeting: Hi {first}, here is your check-in for the week of {date}:
summary.greetingPlain: Here is your check-in for the week of {date}:
summary.sleep: Sleep: {hours} on average over {nights, plural, =1 {1 night} other {# nights}}

picker.title: Add to
picker.addFreeSub: Not in your library yet: it joins it.
picker.none: Nothing here yet. Type its name above to add it anyway.

exerciseSheet.title: Edit
exerciseSheet.alternativesHint: If the machine is taken, the client does one of these instead, with one tap. You will see which in their history.

push.nudgeBody: {coach} is waiting for this week’s check-in.
push.coachToRead: {count, plural, =1 {1 check-in to read} other {# check-ins to read}}
push.coachNotYet: {count, plural, =1 {1 not filed yet} other {# not filed yet}}
push.coachLate: {count, plural, =1 {1 late payment} other {# late payments}}
push.coachPain: {count, plural, =1 {1 pain report to see} other {# pain reports to see}}
push.stepsAsk: Note today’s steps, it takes ten seconds.
push.stepsAndSleepAsk: Note today’s steps and last night’s sleep, it takes ten seconds.

pushSettings.title: Notifications
pushSettings.lede: A reminder in the morning when there is a session, a check-in due or a call, and a word when your coach nudges you. On this phone only.
pushSettings.ledeCoach: A word when a client files a check-in or reports pain, and on the morning of your check-in day, what is waiting: check-ins to read, not filed yet, late payments, pain. On this phone only.
pushSettings.testSent: Sent: it arrives in a few seconds.
pushSettings.testNone: Nothing went out. Turn notifications off and on again.
pushSettings.install: On iPhone, notifications only work in the installed app: Share → “Add to Home Screen”, then open Masse from the icon and come back here.
pushSettings.denied: Notifications are blocked for Masse in the phone’s settings. Allow them there, then come back here.
pushSettings.unsupported: This browser does not receive notifications.
pushSettings.failed: Turning them on failed. Try again.

copySession.title: Copy the session
copySession.rule: A session already on that day is replaced, unless a client has logged sets on it: that one is left alone.
copySession.copy: {count, plural, =0 {Pick a week} =1 {Copy to 1 day} other {Copy to # days}}
copySession.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was copied.} =1 {Copied to 1 day.} other {Copied to # days.}}
copySession.kept: {count, plural, =1 {1 day kept: a client has sets on it.} other {# days kept: clients have sets on them.}}

equivalents.title: Swaps
equivalents.lede: Fancy a change? Pick a food and how much: here is how much of the others gives the same.
equivalents.none: No other food of this family in your coach’s library yet.

messages.title: WhatsApp messages
messages.lede: The messages Masse writes for you: reminders, payments, calls, requests. Rewrite them in your own style (formal or not, emojis, your sign-off). Words in braces are filled in when you send: '{firstname}' becomes the client’s first name.
messages.customCount: {count, plural, one {# message in your style} other {# messages in your style}}

run.title: Check-in run
run.doneHint: Nothing left to read for now. New ones will arrive here.
run.doneSkipped: {count, plural, one {# check-in skipped} other {# check-ins skipped}}
run.doneSkippedHint: Find them by starting the run again, or in To do.
run.again: Go back to the skipped ones
